summary: The 'Edit Service Item (Slides)' editor across FEAT-001/002/003 faithfully implements the approved Revision-4 design and all requirements. Model changes are strictly additive and backward-compatible: only ServiceItem.AudioAttachments and ServiceItem.StageTemplateId were added (both nullable, [JsonPropertyName]-only so WhenWritingNull omits them); ServiceItemSettings is unchanged and no WhenComplete field/enum was introduced. 'When complete' maps directly onto the existing AutoAdvanceGoTo + GoToItemId via the pure, tested SlideAutoAdvanceMap, with the after-condition save delegating to BulkEditService.ParseAfterCondition so bulk-edit and per-item edit agree. Live-link integrity holds: Select sets SlidePresentationId only and never snapshots the name or content; the display name resolves live via ServiceItemDisplayName.ResolveDisplayName. The Save copy-back writes only the enumerated edited fields onto the live item in place (Title only for the non-linked rename case), so Id/Order/ForegroundType/Slides/Song/Scripture fields are never clobbered. RemoveRequested is raised alone and the host sets DialogResult=false, making remove and save mutually exclusive and running RemoveItem -> SaveServiceOrderAsync -> prime -> refresh exactly once. _suppressDirty is set in the ctor and held across the entire awaited OnLoaded population sequence, cleared only in the finally. The editor window and ListPickerDialog correctly merge OwcDesignSystem.xaml and use keyed OWC styles (all referenced keys verified present), per the standalone-Window styling rule. Tests cover audio resolve/migration, JSON round-trip + WhenWritingNull omission, legacy-file load, the full SlideAutoAdvanceMap load/save table incl. VideoEnd->EndOfMedia folding, the SQLite DataJson mirror, the host JSON-file round-trip with SpecificItem+GoToItemId, and that the three real service-order JSONs + demos still deserialize. I independently ran the build (WorshipPlayer.UI -c Debug: Build succeeded, 0 warnings, 0 errors) and the full suite (dotnet test: 812 passed, 0 failed), and performed no bin/obj clean or delete.

findings.detail: Informational only, no action required. The label<->enum mapping was extracted into a new pure Core helper (SlideAutoAdvanceMap) rather than kept as the inline editor-local ToGoTo/GoToLabel equivalents the design text described. This is an improvement, not a deviation: it is unit-tested, keeps the UI thin, and still delegates the after-condition parse to BulkEditService.ParseAfterCondition so the mapping stays consistent with bulk edit. Worth reflecting in the design's file list on a future doc pass for traceability.
